_comment: The harness gate-off'd with itself (#3714). Run: .venv/bin/python scripts/gate_off.py scripts/gate-off-selfcheck.json  (about 30 minutes: a mutant that breaks the restore or the lock makes later fixture runs wait out their deadlines). The RSS ceiling is deliberately NOT mutated here: with it gone the runaway-memory test allocates until the machine is out of memory (the #2730 hazard); it is covered by test_unbounded_allocation_is_reported_as_runaway_memory_with_the_measurement and by reading the one comparison. A mutant that disables a kill leaves the INNER harness's children (each in its own session) running after this outer run kills the inner pytest: afterwards run `pkill -f 'no:django tests/test_calc.py'`.

mutations.label: harness: the applied-check is dropped (a missing or ambiguous text is no longer INVALID)
harness: the no-op check is dropped
harness: the compile check of a .py target is dropped
harness: pytest errors are no longer counted
harness: a collection/import error is no longer INVALID
harness: the restore hash is not verified
harness: the restore is no longer performed in the finally
harness: restore preserves the original mtime (the copy2 hazard)
harness: the stale-bytecode clear matches nothing
harness: children may write bytecode
harness: the deadline never fires (the run is only stopped by this self-check's own deadline)
harness: a failing restore write is swallowed instead of reported
harness: a group that cannot be killed is swallowed
harness: an unavailable ps silently disables the RSS ceiling
mutations.old: raise RuntimeError(f"cannot sample RSS (is `ps` available? POSIX only): {exc}") from exc

mutations.label: harness: the directory lock is never taken
harness: a stale journal is not recovered before the snapshot
harness: the journal is not written before the mutation
harness: a file edited since a killed run is overwritten instead of refused
harness: a symlinked target is replaced by a regular file
harness: an unwritable target is reported as a restore failure
harness: a hang during collection is called a catch
harness: a command that cannot start is a traceback
harness: the PRE-run bytecode clear is dropped
harness: the atexit failsafe is not registered
harness: the process group is not killed once the leader has exited
harness: exit 126/127 under runner=exit is a catch
harness: no CRLF hint
mutations.old: if found == 0 and b"\r\n" in original
mutations.new: if False and b"\r\n" in original

mutations.label: harness: only the first target directory of a multi-file spec is locked
harness: the lock is too coarse (two trees with the same basename share it)
harness: the journal is keyed on the basename only
harness: the default state dir is derived from $HOME again
